column1: # The shortcut keys of every remote in remotes.tsv and the keyboard keys a user may give an app ("Remote buttons",
# apps/core/lumen-remote keys package, README.md "Rebind a button"). One row per key a remote sends that is neither a
# control key (fixed_keys.tsv) nor a plain picture or system key. Read by tools/remotes/gen_catalog.py, which writes
# apps/core/lumen-remote/src/org/lumen/remote/keys/KeyTable.java (never edit that file: edit this table, run the script).
#  remote        id of a remotes.tsv row, or 'keyboard' (any Bluetooth or USB keyboard)
#  scancode      what the remote sends (the stock vendor .kl line), '-' for keyboard rows
#  stock_label   the stock label of that scancode (vendor/usr/keylayout of the models in the remote's stock column)
#  stock_action  what the stock XGIMI system does with it (xgimi_action_config.xml, XRMService XrmDoAction,
#  keycode       the Android key after the Lumen key layout (overlay/v1/keylayout, X50 and RS30 via
#  bind          app = the user may give it an app, no = never rebound (see note)
#  unbound       what the key does while no app is given: host = its normal action, unchanged (a remote key: the
#                projector app's KeyReceiver, a keyboard key: the app in front or Android), all_apps = the launcher's
#                app list, signal = the signal panel (apps/core/lumen-signal), pick = asks which app to open (stock: an unbound custom key opens its edit dialog), - for
#  name          the key's name on the screen, by what is printed on it: lumen_remote_keys_name_<name>. A logo key is
#                named by its logo (youku, tencent, iqiyi, mango, bilibili: XRMService XrmDoAction appName_new2024,
#                the stock default when the remote does not say its version, versions that print another logo are
#                in note), a function key by its stock name (ambient = remote_screen_saver_button, shortcut = the
#                stock "Shortcut Key", custom_N = the stock "Shortcut Keys N"), f = the F key's own label, - for bind=no
